companyDescription: Zoho Corporation is an Indian multinational technology company that makes web-based business tools. It is best known for Zoho Office Suite. Zoho builds software for sales, marketing, support, accounting, and operations with over 55 million users worldwide.

Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security. Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills, they partner with over 6,000 clients in more than 120 countries to drive value and shared success.

Amazon is a multinational technology company focusing on e-commerce, cloud computing (AWS), digital streaming, and AI. AWS is the world's most comprehensive cloud platform, offering over 200 fully featured services from data centers globally.

Google LLC is an American multinational technology company focusing on search engine technology, online advertising, cloud computing, quantum computing, e-commerce, AI, and consumer electronics. It is one of the most valuable companies in the world.

Microsoft is a leading global technology company known for Windows, Azure cloud, Office 365, LinkedIn, and Xbox. Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more through intelligent cloud and intelligent edge.

IBM is an American multinational technology corporation producing computer hardware, middleware, and software, and providing consulting and hosting services. IBM is known for its work in AI (Watson), hybrid cloud, quantum computing, and enterprise solutions.

Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) is an Indian multinational IT services and consulting company and part of the Tata Group. TCS is the largest IT employer in India, providing a broad range of information technology-related products and services.

Infosys Limited is an Indian multinational IT company offering business consulting, information technology, and outsourcing services. Infosys is known for its Infosys BPM and digital transformation capabilities serving clients across 50 countries.

Wipro Limited is an Indian multinational corporation providing IT services, business process services, and consulting. Wipro is well known for its technology and outsourcing services across banking, healthcare, manufacturing, and retail sectors.

Cognizant Technology Solutions is an American multinational IT services and consulting company headquartered in New Jersey. Cognizant is a Fortune 200 company with a focus on digital, cloud, AI, and engineering services for global enterprises.

Deloitte is one of the Big Four accounting organizations and one of the largest professional services networks in the world by revenue and number of professionals. Services include audit, consulting, financial advisory, risk advisory, tax, and legal services.

Capgemini is a French multinational IT services and consulting company. Capgemini partners with companies to transform and manage their businesses by harnessing the power of technology — cloud, AI, data, and intelligent industry solutions.

Oracle Corporation is an American multinational computer technology corporation best known for its Oracle Database and cloud infrastructure services. Oracle Cloud is a top-3 global cloud provider offering IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, and DaaS.

Adobe Inc. is an American multinational computer software company known for its multimedia and creativity software products. Adobe's Creative Cloud suite includes Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, and Acrobat — used by millions of creators worldwide.

Salesforce is a leading global CRM company helping businesses of every size and industry succeed. The Salesforce Customer 360 platform connects marketing, sales, commerce, service, and IT teams with shared views of customer data powered by AI.

Freshworks creates modern SaaS products for IT service, customer support, CRM, and HR management. Founded in Chennai and now headquartered in San Mateo, Freshworks serves more than 65,000 businesses across the globe with its suite of intuitive products.

Tiger Analytics is a global advanced analytics and AI firm providing data science consulting, machine learning engineering, and AI solutions. Their clients span Fortune 500 companies in CPG, retail, financial services, and healthcare.

HCL Technologies (HCLTech) is an Indian multinational IT services company known for its broad portfolio of technology and business services. HCLTech operates across 60 countries with strong expertise in engineering, cloud, security, and AI services.

Flipkart is India's leading e-commerce marketplace offering a wide range of products across electronics, fashion, groceries, and more. Backed by Walmart, Flipkart operates large-scale engineering teams working on supply chain, ML, and platform reliability.

PayPal Holdings, Inc. is an American multinational financial technology company operating an online payments system. PayPal enables digital and mobile payments globally for consumers and merchants, serving over 430 million active accounts in more than 200 markets.
